pageDescription: Information on the procedure for complaining about the AI Psychologist service.

sections.title: 1. General Provisions
content: This complaints policy governs the method and conditions for complaining about services provided under the paid subscription (Premium) on the Psychollog.cz platform (hereinafter referred to as 'Service').

sections.title: 2. Subject of Complaint
content: A complaint can be filed if the paid Service does not correspond to the features and functions described in the Terms and Conditions and on the Service's website.

The subject of a complaint may particularly be the demonstrable technical unavailability of paid functions for a significant period, not caused by the User or circumstances on their part (e.g., internet connection failure).

sections.title: 3. How to File a Complaint
content: The User is obliged to file a complaint without undue delay after discovering a defect, via email to the address:
The Operator will confirm receipt of the complaint by email.
list: User's identification data (email used for registration).
A detailed description of the claimed defect and the time it occurred.
Proof of payment for the subscription (e.g., confirmation from the payment gateway).

sections.title: 4. Deadlines and Complaint Resolution
content: The Operator undertakes to resolve the complaint no later than 30 days from its receipt.

In the case of a justified complaint, the User will be provided with reasonable compensation, for example, an extension of the subscription for the period of the Service's unavailability, or in justified cases, a refund of a proportionate part of the paid subscription.

sections.title: 5. Final Provisions
content: This complaints policy is an integral part of the Terms and Conditions.
